com.vector.cfg.model.abstraction.api

Interface IIdentifiable

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasModelObject, IModelAbstraction
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    IAbstractSignalInstance, IComponent, IComponentType, IConnector, IEvent, IExecutableEntity, IExecutionOrderConstraint, IPortInterface, ISignalGroupInstance, ISignalInstance

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IIdentifiable
extends IModelAbstraction
    Model abstraction for an Identifiable. In AUTOSAR instances of an Identifiable can be referred to by their shortname and may contain other Identifiables.

      • getMdfObject

        @PublishedMethod
com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.base.MIIdentifiable getMdfObject()
        Description copied from interface: IModelAbstraction
        Returns the underlying IModelObject of this wrapper instance.

        The method will never return null.

        IModelAbstraction.getMdfObject() is a bridge from the IModelAbstraction to the underlying MDF object. For compound model abstractions, the main object will be returned, e.g. returns the port for a component port.

        The returned MIObject is as most specific as possible (e.g. MIIdentifiable) but AUTOSAR version independent. For more advanced features, it has to be cast to the actual used element (e.g. MIAssemblySwConnector) according to AUTOSAR. This can be determined by MDFBaseObject.mdfGetInterfaceClass().

        Specified by:
        getMdfObject in interface IHasModelObject
        Specified by:
        getMdfObject in interface IModelAbstraction
        Returns:
        The IModelObject of this IHasModelObject.
